products.name: Proof Selection Approval
products.product: A focused photography client proof selection and approval workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent photography studios and small commercial photo teams
products.problem: Clients favorite images, comment in email, request retouching, and revise selections without one authoritative decision set tied to exact image versions.
products.valueProposition: Turns photography client proof selection and approval into a visible operating queue so every client selection and approval identifies the exact images, revision, intended output, approver, and final decision.
products.topic: photography client proof selection and approval
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets photography proofing workflow, client photo selection, photo approval software, and photography gallery approvals searches.

products.name: Shoot Readiness Board
products.product: A focused photography shoot readiness tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent photography studios and small commercial photo teams
products.problem: A booked shoot can still lack signed scope, call times, location access, subject list, permits, props, equipment, weather plan, or client confirmation.
products.valueProposition: Turns photography shoot readiness tracking into a visible operating queue so every scheduled shoot reaches a verified go, revised, or postponed decision with people, place, scope, and production resources aligned.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets photography shoot checklist, photo shoot call sheet, studio shoot planning, and photography production readiness searches.
